Slate, sage and pale mineral strokes fall through the canvas like heavy rain.

A quiet, contemplative piece. The original has been sold; a new work in this spirit can be commissioned.

Seen at scale

Quiet Monsoon measures 30 × 30 in (76 × 76 cm). The drawing shows it above a three-seat sofa so you can picture it on your own wall.

Need it larger, smaller or in a different proportion? Sizes can be adapted.

Make it your own

This painting can be adapted to suit your space — in its size, its palette, its details and its framing — while keeping the character of the original.

  • Size & Proportion

    Scaled up or down, or re-proportioned to suit a particular wall, alcove or piece of furniture.

  • Colour Palette

    Tones shifted to sit comfortably with your walls, upholstery, flooring or existing art.

  • Artwork Details

    Elements such as texture, metallic accents, density of detail or composition refined for your setting.

  • Framing

    Finished with the frame that suits the room, or left unframed for a clean gallery edge.
